title: Design System: Words of Life Christian Ministries

display.purpose: Full-screen hero lockups and maximum-scale section anchors. Vogun only. UPPERCASE declares, lowercase confides.

headline.purpose: Section introductions, modal titles, full-screen nav items. The intimate register of Vogun.

title.purpose: Card headings, sidebar labels, admin panel section titles.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, descriptions, modal body. Max 65ch line length.

label.purpose: Navigation links, button text, overlines, floating input labels. The system's smallest and sharpest type.

shadows.name: ember-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA buttons only. The halo that signals interactability. Not a lift, a light.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns and overlays. Paired with backdrop-blur-xl. Provides disambiguation without a hard edge.

motion.name: house-curve
motion.purpose: Significant transitions: menu open/close, clip-path reveals, hero entrances. 500ms–750ms duration.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Smaller state transitions: hover, focus, color changes. 150ms–300ms duration.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Live indicator dots only. Ember fill, 6px circle.

narrative.overview:
WLCM's visual system is built on a single premise: navigation by faith in the absence of easy clarity. The dominant surface is ocean-floor dark — a darkness that earns meaning rather than evokes mood. Type is the signal. Vogun, WLCM's custom serif, appears at full-screen scale and functions as a landmark: a declaration that tells you exactly where you are. Outfit handles everything functional with military precision. The single accent, Ember, does not decorate. It points. Every appearance of Ember is directional — a CTA, an active state, a live indicator, a label that says 'go here.'

The system refuses two failure modes simultaneously. The first is the generic megachurch SaaS template: stock photography of praying hands, warm gradient CTAs, 'Join Us This Sunday' in Proxima Nova. The second is the startup-minimalist white page that reduces faith to a brand statement. WLCM is darker and more specific than either.
keyCharacteristics: Typography-led: Vogun at display scale IS the design moment
Flat tonal depth: no resting shadows; depth through layered opacities and tonal steps
One accent: Ember on no more than 10% of any public-facing surface
Pill geometry throughout: nav, buttons, chips — never square corners on interactive elements
Case as register: UPPERCASE = formal/institutional authority, lowercase = intimate/approachable

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember appears on no more than 10% of any given public-facing screen. Its scarcity is the mechanism. The instant it fills backgrounds or appears in body copy, it stops pointing and starts cluttering.

rules.name: The Light-Flip Rule
rules.body: Admin surfaces flip to Cold Shore base and white panels. The dark cinematic aesthetic serves atmosphere on public pages; it impedes productivity in the admin layer.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest at the same level. Shadows appear only as a response to state. No decorative box-shadows on cards, sections, or containers.

rules.name: The Vogun Threshold Rule
rules.body: Vogun below 1.5rem is forbidden. Its letterforms are built for scale; collapsed, they lose legibility and authority simultaneously.

rules.name: The Case Register Rule
rules.body: UPPERCASE Vogun declares; it is the voice of the institution. Lowercase Vogun confides. The same word carries entirely different weight depending on case.

rules.name: The Open Form Rule
rules.body: No rectangular input wrappers, no background-fill boxes, no rounded corners on text fields. The underline-only treatment preserves the open, planar aesthetic of the form.

dos: Do use Ember to point, never to decorate.
Do reserve Vogun for display and headline scale.
Do vary UPPERCASE vs. lowercase Vogun with intention.
Do use underline-only inputs with transparent backgrounds.
Do flip to the light register for admin and tool surfaces.
Do use the house easing curve cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1) for significant transitions.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for clip-path reveals, the circle menu expand, and pulse animations.
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast ratios, especially with opacity-modified text.
donts: Don't use stock photography of praying hands or faded cross imagery.
Don't put meaningful content on an all-white background with 14px light-weight Outfit.
Don't apply gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient).
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't put Ember on more than 10% of any public-facing screen.
Don't add decorative box-shadows or glassmorphism effects to card surfaces.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing curves.
Don't use identical-grid layouts of same-sized cards with icon + heading + text.
